news.title: Guesthouse rooms, shops and guard cabins razed as DLF-3 drive resumes in Gurugram
news.para: On Monday, authorities in Gurugram took decisive action by sealing a guesthouse and dismantling illegal structures. This enforcement activity saw the removal of four unauthorized rooms in stilt parking areas and the clearing of commercial buildings along Moulsari Avenue Road and in V Block. Additionally, officials dismantled guard rooms occupying public land in front of residences, signaling ongoing efforts against illegal constructions in residential neighborhoods.

news.title: Delhi government's housing colonies to get highrise makeover
news.para: The Delhi government is set to embark on an ambitious redevelopment project for PWD housing colonies. Under the TOD policy, existing flats will be transformed into sleek multi-storeyed buildings, with Gulabi Bagh, Kalyanwas, and Bahapur leading the initiative. This self-financing model will generate revenue from the sale of residential and commercial spaces to fund the new Delhi Secretariat complex construction.

news.title: MTNL, BSNL and RINL's ₹13,500 crore worth of realty assets to hit markets
news.para: Realty assets worth an estimated ₹13,500 crore belonging to MTNL, BSNL and RINL are set to hit the market after the Department of Public Enterprises gave final approval for their monetisation. The National Land Monetisation Corp will market 23 prime properties across six cities, targeting ₹7,500 crore this fiscal.

news.title: Bain Capital sells 5.64% unitholding in Embassy Office Parks REIT for ₹2,325 crore
news.para: Bain Capital sold a 5.64% stake in Embassy Office Parks REIT for Rs 2,325 crore, which involved over 53 million units. Amidst this change, Embassy REIT is gearing up to acquire ten to twelve million square feet of office space and is in the process of building an additional six point two million square feet.

news.title: Enforcement directorate attaches assets ₹129.80 crore in alleged real estate fraud in Ahmedabad
news.para: The Enforcement Directorate has provisionally attached assets totaling Rs 152.5 crore in Gujarat, unveiling two separate money laundering cases. One investigation revolves around a deceitful government office operation in Dahod, while the other shines a light on a real estate fraud scheme in Ahmedabad city. These efforts are crucial for reclaiming diverted public resources and supporting swindled home buyers.

news.title: Tamil Nadu government mandates online registration for first sale of plots, flats
news.para: Tamil Nadu has instituted mandatory online registration for initial property sales. This innovative system aims to boost transparency while minimizing the need for in-person visits to government offices. Builders and applicants can now conveniently upload their documents through the TNREGINET portal. Additionally, biometric authentication helps streamline the process, with registered documents embedded with digital signatures and QR codes for easy verification.

news.title: NBCC moves SC for RERA exemptions to complete 16 stalled Supertech projects
news.para: The Supreme Court is set to review the National Buildings Construction Corporation's (NBCC) request concerning RERA compliance for Supertech's housing projects. NBCC is seeking exemptions from mandatory regulations to renovate stalled developments. This appeal comes after the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal denied similar requests. Previously, the apex court instructed NBCC to accelerate the project completions, with construction for sixteen Supertech projects slated to commence shortly.

news.title: UltraTech Cement to invest ₹16,000 crore to add over 240 MTPA capacity by FY28
news.para: UltraTech Cement’s consolidated net revenue rose 17% to ₹88,512 crore in FY26, while EBITDA increased 32% to ₹17,598 crore. The company plans to invest ₹16,000 crore to increase total cement capacity to over 240 MTPA by FY28.

news.title: New home prices in China stagnant in July as demand stays weak
news.para: In July, China's new home prices showed no signs of movement, indicating a persistence of low demand. The month-to-month prices dipped 0.1%, echoing June's downturn, while annual prices dropped by 3.2%, slightly better than the previous month. Only seventeen cities experienced any month-on-month price increases, hinting at a sluggish recovery, and this trend suggests the property market remains in a phase of adjustment.

news.title: EFC (I) leases 95,897 sq ft office space; VFS Global launches model sub-registrar office in Pune
news.para: EFC (I) has successfully secured a substantial property in Pune, which will introduce over two thousand additional seats to its operational capacity. This significant growth comes right after the company’s takeover of Ultrafresh, enhancing its managed office services. Furthermore, VFS Global and WE Excel Software have inaugurated Maharashtra's pioneering model sub-registrar office in Pune, designed to improve property registration facilities for residents.

news.title: Gujarat CM announces free residential plots for rural families
news.para: Gujarat's Chief Minister revealed plans for free residential plots targeted at deserving rural families. This initiative is complemented by a robust road improvement scheme with a budget of Rs 3,428 crore. Furthermore, supplemental nutrition rates for anganwadi children will experience a noteworthy increase of 67%. Additionally, the state has elevated the income limits for overseas education loans for unreserved students.

news.title: Suraj Estate Developers' net profit rises 7% to ₹22.85 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Suraj Estate Developers' consolidated total income increased 9.8 per cent to ₹146.23 crore during the quarter. Sales value rose 74 per cent year-on-year to ₹141 crore, while collections stood at ₹86 crore.

news.title: Lucknow civic body launches one-time settlement scheme for 12.24 lakh building owners
news.para: The Lucknow Municipal Corporation has introduced a unique one-time settlement scheme aimed at facilitating house tax collection. Under this initiative, defaulters are granted a complete waiver on accumulated interest and surcharges if they clear their outstanding dues within thirty days. This program, designed to boost the collection of dues from urban bodies, is available to all eligible taxpayers until December fifteenth.

news.title: Bhubaneswar civic body approves merger of 46 villages near city
news.para: The Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation is set to expand its boundaries by integrating forty-six villages into its fold. The inclusion comes after the villages expressed their desire for urban facilities, fulfilling eligibility standards through a detailed assessment. Residents will start paying holding tax and user fees to access enhanced civic services.

news.title: Maharashtra releases draft model bye-laws 2026 for housing societies
news.para: Maharashtra's cooperation department has unveiled the draft Model Bye-Laws 2026 for housing societies, focusing on key areas like redevelopment, parking solutions, and electric vehicle charging installations. This comprehensive draft aims to enhance structural safety and establish grievance redressal systems for the state’s over 1.25 lakh societies. Citizens are encouraged to share their feedback until August 27, influencing the finalization of these essential governance regulations.

news.title: Chandigarh: Parveen Kansal’s bail rejected in  ₹47.89 crore Royal City money laundering case
news.para: Parveen Kansal's request for bail was denied by the court amid serious allegations of money laundering. Documentary evidence substantiating claims of fund siphoning was submitted, leading the court to express concerns over potential evidence tampering and the risk of the accused fleeing. The Enforcement Directorate maintained that Kansal retained control over the firm despite her resignation, with assets valued at around Rs 10.

news.title: Over 50% of flats sold on first day under Delhi development body's housing scheme
news.para: Over half of the new ready-to-move flats were sold, with one-bedroom units disappearing within mere hours. The DDA's Karamjeewi Awaas Yojana 2026 introduces homes at a 25% discount, primarily benefiting government employees and working professionals in search of affordable living solutions. As connectivity and infrastructure improve, Narela becomes increasingly attractive to prospective residents.

news.title: DLF-3 demolition drive to resume, stilt parking violations under lens in Gurugram
news.para: Starting from Monday, the DTCP will resume its demolition and sealing operations in DLF-3. Property owners have been issued final warnings to dismantle illegal structures and halt any commercial activities. The enforcement will focus on unauthorized buildings and the misuse of residential properties for commercial purposes, with the goal of reinstating the area's residential integrity. Progress in legal proceedings before the High Court now permits the enforcement actions to continue.
